newsitem.title: POLAND: Novita sees bond issue at PLN 20 mln.
newsitem.headline: Novita sees bond issue at PLN 20 mln.

text.p: Polish carpet maker Novita SA expects to raise about 20 million zlotys from its planned convertible bond issue at the beginning of the second half of the year, the company's president said on Friday.

Marek Gorny told Reuters that Novita's general shareholders meeting on May 20 would vote on the convertible bonds and said proceeds from the issue would be used for investments in a new production line and modernisation of its existing plant.
"We expect to raise about 20 million zlotys from the issue and we would like to earmark the funds for our three-year investment programme," he said. @
He said the company would like foreign and domestic financial investors to take up the bonds, but stressed that it had no plans to acquire a strategic investor.
Gorny said the investment programme would amount to 30 million zlotys and said the remaining 10 million zlotys would come from the company's own funds.
He gave no other details on the issue.
